name: Isosurface Ray Marching with Blinn-Phong Shading
aliases: Ray Marching with Slab Intersection and Blinn-Phong Shading
definition: A volume rendering technique that casts rays from the camera through each pixel, intersects them with an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) of the volume, and marches along the ray to find the first voxel exceeding a threshold, then computes shading using a Blinn-Phong model.
